articles.title: Home and vehicle catch fire in Markham
articles.summary: A fire broke out at a Markham residence on Monday night. Fire crews were called to a home cul-de-sac at Rose Way and Natalie Court, near Ninth Line and Highway 7, just before 9 p.m. Authorities say the residence and a vehicle caught fire and that the home was evacuated. No injuries were reported. Footage […]

articles.title: Fire at funeral home in Oshawa deemed suspicious: Durham police
articles.summary: A fire at a funeral home in Oshawa, Ont. Monday has been deemed suspicious, according to Durham police.

articles.title: ‘It is a total loss:’ Downtown Oshawa funeral home destroyed after overnight fire
articles.summary: Oshawa firefighters were called to the area of the McIntosh-Anderson-Kellam Funeral Home just before 4 a.m. on Monday.

articles.title: Blue Jays claim catcher Shawn Ross off waivers from Mets
articles.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays claimed catcher Shawn Ross off waivers from the New York Mets on Saturday. Ross was then optioned to triple-A Buffalo.

articles.title: 2 men dead after car hits traffic light pole, knocks it down in North York: Toronto police
articles.summary: Toronto police say two men are dead following a single-vehicle collision in North York overnight.
